introduction_markdown: This paper is arranged in two sections, A and B. Answer ALL questions in Sections A and B. Section A: Answer ALL the questions in the spaces provided (15 questions); the mark allocation for each question is indicated. Section B: Answer ALL FOUR questions in this section; all questions in Section B carry equal marks (15 marks each). You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage. Calculators are allowed. Duration: two and a half hours.
enonce_intro_markdown: A farmer employed two students and three men to clear his farm for two weeks, working 5 days a week. The two students each received $2{,}000$ FCFA per day and each of the three men received $3{,}000$ FCFA per day.
incertitudes: Q B1 : « Calculate his total expenses » est lu comme main-d'oeuvre (130 000) + produits chimiques (78 000) + autres dépenses (35 000) = 243 000 FCFA. La question (e) est lue : part de la première épouse en pourcentage du montant partagé entre les deux épouses (60 %). Le barème imprimé est de 15 marks pour toute la question (pas de points par partie).

questions.enonce_markdown:
(a) Calculate the total amount that the farmer spent on his workers for clearing his farm within two weeks.

Given that the total amount the farmer used to buy chemicals for spraying is $\dfrac35$ of the total amount spent on clearing.
questions.corrige_markdown:
Number of working days: $2\text{ weeks}\times5\text{ days}=10$ days.

Pay per day: students $2\times2{,}000=4{,}000$ FCFA; men $3\times3{,}000=9{,}000$ FCFA; total per day $=13{,}000$ FCFA.

Total for clearing $=10\times13{,}000=130{,}000$ FCFA.

**The farmer spent $130{,}000$ FCFA on his workers.**

questions.enonce_markdown: (b) Calculate the amount used for buying chemicals. Other expenses summed up to $35{,}000$ FCFA.
questions.corrige_markdown:
Chemicals $=\dfrac35\times130{,}000=3\times26{,}000=78{,}000$ FCFA.

**The amount used for buying chemicals is $78{,}000$ FCFA.**

questions.enonce_markdown:
(c) Calculate his total expenses.

Given also that he sold all his produce at $620{,}500$ FCFA and $30\%$ of his profit was shared between his first and the second wives in the ratio $3:2$.
questions.corrige_markdown:
Total expenses $=$ clearing $+$ chemicals $+$ other expenses

$=130{,}000+78{,}000+35{,}000=243{,}000$ FCFA.

**Total expenses $=243{,}000$ FCFA.**

questions.enonce_markdown: (d) Find the amount shared between his two wives.
questions.corrige_markdown:
Profit $=$ selling price $-$ total expenses $=620{,}500-243{,}000=377{,}500$ FCFA.

Amount shared $=30\%$ of the profit $=\dfrac{30}{100}\times377{,}500=113{,}250$ FCFA.

In the ratio $3:2$ (5 parts): one part $=\dfrac{113{,}250}{5}=22{,}650$ FCFA, so the first wife gets $3\times22{,}650=67{,}950$ FCFA and the second wife $2\times22{,}650=45{,}300$ FCFA.

Check: $67{,}950+45{,}300=113{,}250$.

**The amount shared between the two wives is $113{,}250$ FCFA.**

questions.enonce_markdown: (e) Express the amount received by the first wife as a percentage of the amount shared between his wives. *[15 marks for the whole question]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
First wife's amount $=67{,}950$ FCFA; amount shared $=113{,}250$ FCFA.

Percentage $=\dfrac{67{,}950}{113{,}250}\times100=60\%$.

(This agrees with the ratio: $\dfrac35=60\%$.)

**The first wife received $60\%$ of the amount shared.**
